Let <MATH_0001> be a flat morphism of schemes. Let <MATH_0002> be a
quasi-compact morphism of schemes. Let <MATH_0003> be the scheme theoretic
image of <MATH_0004> and let <MATH_0005> be the scheme theoretic image of the
base change <MATH_0006>. Then <MATH_0007>.

Recall that <MATH_0001> is cut out by
<MATH_0002>
and <MATH_0003> is cut out by
<MATH_0004>, see
Lemma <REF_0001>.
Hence the question is local on <MATH_0005> and <MATH_0006> and we may assume <MATH_0007> and <MATH_0008>
affine. Note that we may replace <MATH_0009> by <MATH_0010> where
<MATH_0011> is a finite affine open covering.
Hence we may assume <MATH_0012> is affine. In this case
<MATH_0013> is the pullback
of <MATH_0014> by <MATH_0015>. Since <MATH_0016> is flat we conclude that
<MATH_0017> and the lemma holds.
